nodes.label: Layer direction hard rule (import-linter enforced)
nodes.rationale: ui/api -> investigations -> agentruntime -> research -> dataplatform -> knowledge -> observability -> core; AI code confined to agentruntime/, adapter.py is the only ADK importer.

nodes.label: Documents are immutable (DB trigger)
nodes.rationale: Never write an UPDATE path for documents; derived artifacts keyed on (document_id, stage, pipeline_version) and re-derivable from the raw store.

nodes.label: Events are append-only; jobs is a disposable outbox
Every AI output carries citations
nodes.rationale: Evidence without a chunk reference is rejected.

nodes.label: Confidence is computed, never LLM-generated
nodes.rationale: Source diversity, recency, stance agreement drive the deterministic score.

nodes.label: Sync code only (ADR-0004)
nodes.rationale: Sync SQLAlchemy, sync httpx, def endpoints; no async because I/O volume doesn't justify the complexity.

nodes.label: DB clock is the only time authority for queue predicates
nodes.rationale: func.now(), never datetime.now(); WSL2 wall clock steps backward up to 1.8s (commit 9b1d07e).

nodes.label: Job lifecycle: pending -> running -> completed | retry | dead
ponytail: comments naming ceiling + upgrade path
orchestrator._advance() fan-in readiness lock gotcha
nodes.rationale: with_for_update() on pending sibling rows required because two workers completing sibling tasks concurrently can each see the other as not-complete under READ COMMITTED, so neither enqueues the dependent (ADR-0010).

nodes.label: Task readiness derived on read, never stored
nodes.rationale: investigation_tasks readiness computed from dependency states (migration 0006); don't add a ready column.
